title: Input Validation with Zod Schemas
goal: Implement comprehensive input validation using Zod schemas for all API endpoints to prevent invalid data, injection attacks, and ensure data integrity.

sub_tasks.title: Create Auth Validators
sub_tasks.output: Zod schemas for login, register, refreshToken, and setup endpoints in auth.validator.ts

sub_tasks.title: Create Public API Validators
sub_tasks.output: Zod schemas for contact, newsletter, schedule-visit, post-property endpoints in public.validator.ts

sub_tasks.title: Create Call Intelligence Validators
sub_tasks.output: Zod schemas for call upload and submission in calls.validator.ts

sub_tasks.title: Create Validate Middleware
sub_tasks.output: Generic validate middleware function in validators/index.ts to apply Zod schemas to request body/query/params

acceptance_criteria: All authentication endpoints have Zod validation schemas
All public API endpoints have Zod validation schemas
Call intelligence endpoints have Zod validation schemas
Validate middleware properly integrates with Express routes
Clear validation error messages returned to clients
Email validation for all email fields
result_summary: Complete input validation system using Zod schemas. All major endpoint categories covered: auth (login, register, refresh, setup), public API (contact, newsletter, schedule-visit, post-property), and call intelligence (upload, submit). Generic validate middleware created for easy integration. Prevents injection attacks, ensures data integrity, and provides clear error messages for invalid input.
